adoration.text: Adoration Room daily 08:00–21:30. Bulletin says no Parish Holy Hour in October 2026.

confession.text: 30 minutes before Saturday sunset Mass and all Sunday Masses; ceases when Mass begins.

devotions.text: Rosary Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri 17:30 in CHS Chapel. Divine Mercy Wednesdays 17:15 in Chapel. First Friday Sacred Heart devotion/Eucharistic Adoration after 18:00 Mass in Chapel. Last Friday Compline 20:00–21:00 via Zoom. On the 13th monthly, Legion of Mary Rosary at Grotto after 18:00 Mass, replacing 17:30 Chapel rosary that day. No prayer sessions on public holidays; times subject to change.
October Rosary: 30 minutes before weekend Masses and weekday evening Masses except Wednesdays. No Parish Holy Hour during October 2026.
